content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-<nonce>' 'strict-dynamic' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://res.cloudinary.com; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://api.cloudinary.com; frame-src https://challenges.cloudflare.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; manifest-src 'self'; media-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
permissions-policy: camera=(self), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
